mechanism: Glipizide may impair vitamin B12 absorption through effects on gastric intrinsic factor and calcium-dependent B12 binding, while cyanocobalamin supplementation helps counteract B12 deficiency that can be induced by sulfonylureas.
action: Monitor B12 levels periodically in patients on chronic glipizide therapy; cyanocobalamin supplementation is appropriate for documented deficiency and may improve glycemic control and reduce neuropathy risk.
